_notes.purpose: Legitimate shopping traffic, used to measure the guardrail's FALSE-POSITIVE rate. The original red-team corpus contained only attacks, so a guard that blocked everything would have scored 100% containment.
_notes.hard_negatives: The hard_negatives category is deliberately adversarial toward the regex layer: ordinary requests that happen to contain trigger words (ignore, cancel, admin, developer mode, roleplay, secret, clear ... check, ---START). These are where false positives actually come from.
_notes.tuning_rule: Written once, in commit order, BEFORE measuring against it. Do not tune PatternGuard to pass these specific strings and then quote this set's FPR as a held-out number; add new prompts instead.
